positions.name: MigrationDecisionEstablishment
positions.frame: How is the database migration decision established — performed as settled and justified through quantified benefit?
positions.why: All three expressions cohere around the establishment of the PostgreSQL→QuantumDB migration decision. src-1 and src-3 perform the decision as settled (decision conviction, present-progressive declaration and arrow notation), while src-2 justifies it through quantified cost/benefit claims (claim conviction, market-pricing relational framing). The tension between performing the decision as done and arguing for it with projected benefits is held by the frame — the decision is simultaneously announced and supported, with src-3 bridging both modes by recording the decision formally while itemizing its quantified gains.
